title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership | TechCrunch
summary: During its second-quarter earnings call on Tuesday, Spotify again teased the upcoming release of a new product that will allow music fans to leverage AI to make covers and remixes of artists’ music, with the artists’ consent.
